notes:
Sourced from Christie's official PDF "TECHNICAL SPECS - PANDORAS BOX PLAYER R4" (dated July 2, 2020), hosted at christiedigital.com/globalassets — this is the full-size rackmount "Pandoras Box Player," distinct from the smaller "Pandoras Box Compact Player" (which has different I/O: external DC-barrel PSU, D-Sub RS-232, fewer USB ports) and from the higher-end "Pandoras Box Server" line. Christie's own product page for this SKU now 404s and the device is listed under "Discontinued Products"; Christie Digital Systems Germany GmbH sold the entire Pandoras Box product line to twoloox GmbH in October 2025.

Chassis: 422 x 177 x 646mm (WxHxD, no handles) / 482 x 177 x 686mm (with handles) — 482mm width and 177mm height correspond to a 19", ~4U rackmount chassis; weight ~30kg. Server-grade Xeon workstation with up to 8x RAID hard drives (RAID1/5 depending on Performance Kit PK1-PK4).

Optional accessories mentioned in the datasheet but NOT modeled as ports here (connector specifics not given, or not standard-fit): ASIO audio card (8ch ADAT output / 32ch ADAT output / 64ch MADI output — physical connector unspecified), DMX Link In, DMX Link Out, SMPTE Link, NET Link (I/O Links). RS-232/RS-422 control is listed only as a software capability ("via Widget Designer/Spark"); unlike the Compact Player R4 (which explicitly has a rear D-Sub DE-9 RS-232 port), this Player R4 datasheet's hardware table does not itemize a dedicated physical RS-232 port, so none is included here.

Video render engine outputs (0/1/2/4 of the 4 DisplayPorts active) and video-layer/effects counts are software capabilities, not physical ports, and are omitted.

ports.name: DisplayPort 1
ports.note: 1 of 4 DisplayPort 1.2 outputs on the onboard Nvidia Quadro P4000; max 4096x2160@60Hz. Christie ships 4x DisplayPort-to-single-link-DVI adapters so any/all of these outputs can instead run as DVI-D (not modeled as a separate port).

ports.name: 1GbE Ethernet 2
ports.note: Optional dual 10GbE Ethernet expansion card available; not included standard and physical connector detail not confirmed.

ports.name: USB 3.0 (Front)
ports.note: x2 front-panel ports, per datasheet ('USB 3.0: 2 front + 9 back').

ports.name: USB 3.0 (Rear)
ports.note: x9 rear-panel ports, as literally stated in Christie's spec sheet.

ports.name: SDI In (Optional Card)
ports.note: Field-installable optional video input card, max 1 per unit. Christie offers Single, Dual, or Quad 3G HD-SDI, or Single/Dual DVI as mutually exclusive alternatives; this entry represents the top-spec Quad 3G HD-SDI configuration (up to 4x BNC inputs). Not installed standard.

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: 100-240V AC, 47-63Hz, ~850W (rated current listed as 12-6A across the voltage range). Datasheet does not picture/name the exact inlet shell (standard IEC C13/C14 assumed given the wattage) or confirm whether the supply is single or redundant/hot-swap.
